greetings: Namaste! Did you bring chai? No? Then what are you doing here?
Ah, the hero arrives. Please tell me you didn't step on my rangoli outside.
Welcome. I have foreseen your arrival using ancient Vedic astrology... and also because I saw you sprinting past the iron golem.
guild_master.reward: Take these emeralds. Do not spend them all on spicy panipuri, it will ruin your digestion.

farmer: You think farming is easy? Try growing wheat during the monsoon. It's basically underwater basket weaving.
My friend, these carrots have enough spice to make an Enderman cry.
Do not touch my beetroot. It is a sacred family heirloom from the Harappan civilization.
I asked the iron golem to plow the field. Now I have a crater.
The crows here are fearless. Yesterday one stole my turban and flew to the village center.
If you chew enough sugarcane, you don't need a dentist. This is ayurvedic fact.
The universe is an illusion, but this potato is very real and it costs three emeralds.
I am trying to crossbreed wheat with ginger. The result will be explosive.
You want a discount? Do I look like a charity? The monsoon was bad this year!
I have dedicated my life to the soil. And the soil has dedicated its life to ruining my sandals.
fisherman: I caught a fish so big yesterday, I had to register it for a PAN card.
The waters of this river are sacred. Please stop throwing your cobblestone into it.
You call that a fishing rod? My grandmother could catch a whale with a piece of string and a samosa.
I do not fear the Drowned. I fear my mother-in-law when I return with no fish.
Would you like some Hilsa fish? It has more bones than a skeleton spawner, but the taste is divine.
This salmon traveled all the way from the Himalayas just to be sold to you for one emerald. Appreciate its journey.
Pufferfish? We just call it the spicy balloon of the sea.
I meditate by the river to achieve inner peace. Also, it's a great excuse to avoid chores.
I once saw a tiger drinking from the river. I offered it a fish. We are bros now.
Death is inevitable, but a good fish curry makes the wait enjoyable.
shepherd: These sheep are not just wool, they are my children. Now buy their sweaters or leave.
I tried feeding them turmeric to get yellow wool. It just made them sneeze violently.
Do not look the pink sheep directly in the eyes. It knows your sins.
Have you tried counting sheep to sleep? I tried, but they keep arguing with me in Marathi.
I shear them, they grow it back. It is the endless cycle of Samsara.
My neighbor's cows think they are better than my sheep just because they are holy. Pretentious bovines.
This wool is softer than a Bollywood romance.
I charge extra for the white wool because it shows stains. It is a premium feature.
If a creeper blows up near my flock again, I will personally complain to the village panchayat.
The silence of the pasture is deafening. It reminds me of the vast emptiness of the cosmos.
fletcher: You want arrows? I make them with the precision of Vedic mathematics. Zero errors.
These feathers came from a chicken that survived three lightning strikes. It is very auspicious.
I can shoot an apple off a zombie's head. I haven't done it, but I can.
Buy a bow, or I will start reciting my poetry. Your choice.
An arrow is a meditation on focus. Also, it's pointy and hurts.
I used bamboo for this shaft. Very eco-friendly, very sustainable. Five emeralds.
Do not aim this at the cows. I repeat, DO NOT aim this at the cows.
I once tried to make an arrow out of sugarcane. It was delicious but aerodynamically tragic.
You miss 100% of the shots you don't take. And 90% of the ones you do take with this lag.
The path of the arrow is predetermined by karma. Aiming is just a formality.
cleric: I have brewed a potion that cures all ailments! Side effects include glowing in the dark and sudden urges to dance.
This redstone has the energy of a thousand chakras. Be careful.
I asked the gods for wisdom, and they gave me a brewing stand. I think they misunderstood.
You look cursed. Have you tried rubbing turmeric on it?
I do not deal in black magic. Unless you have 64 emeralds, then we can talk.
My lapis lazuli is sourced directly from the heavens. Or a cave, I forget.
The zombie infection is just a severe dosha imbalance. Drink this spicy kadha.
I sense a disturbance in your aura. You haven't paid your taxes, have you?
To transcend the mortal coil, one must first consume this suspicious stew.
We are all just villagers in the great simulation of life. But my potions are real.
weaponsmith: This sword was folded one thousand times. Just like my laundry. Not at all.
A good sword is like a good curry. Sharp, heavy, and leaves your enemies crying.
I sell axes too. Perfect for chopping wood or settling family disputes over land.
Do you think swords are violent? It is merely a tool for aggressive negotiations.
I enchanted this sword with 'Bane of Arthropods'. Because I really hate mosquitoes.
An iron sword for iron men. But please keep it away from magnets.
I once crafted a sword so sharp, it cut through the fabric of reality and hit a pig in the next chunk.
You wield that sword like you are stirring a giant pot of biryani. Put some wrist into it!
The blade reflects the soul of the wielder. Yours looks a bit rusty.
Every swing is a dance with death. Make sure you lead.
armorer: This chestplate will protect you from skeletons, creepers, and the judgmental stares of aunties.
Iron armor gets so hot in the summer, you can fry a jalebi on it.
I recommend the chainmail. It provides excellent ventilation for the monsoon humidity.
Why wear diamond when you can wear iron? Iron builds character. And back pain.
This helmet is guaranteed to protect your head. Your ego, however, is on its own.
I once made a full suit of armor out of gold. Then I realized I couldn't walk. Very shiny mistake.
A warrior without armor is just a very confident snack for a zombie.
I polish these boots with pure ghee. They smell amazing, but ants are a problem.
You must protect your vital organs. Specifically your stomach, for more samosas.
Armor cannot protect you from the inevitable decay of all things. But it helps against arrows.
toolsmith: A good pickaxe is a miner's best friend. A bad pickaxe is a fast track to a lava bath.
I made this shovel extra wide so you can dig yourself out of the holes you talk yourself into.
Do not use my hoes for combat. Have some respect for the agricultural arts.
This axe is so sharp it chopped down a tree before I even swung it. It's very proactive.
I forged this iron in the flames of a spicy vindaloo. It is unbreakable.
A tool is only as smart as the villager using it. I am not offering a warranty.
I once tried to mine obsidian with a wooden pickaxe. It taught me the true meaning of patience.
Buy a shovel. Bury your regrets. It's highly therapeutic.
The rhythmic sound of mining is the heartbeat of the earth. Don't ruin it by breaking your pickaxe.
Creation and destruction are two sides of the same coin. This pickaxe does both.
butcher: I only sell ethically sourced, free-range, grass-fed... oh who am I kidding, it's just pork.
Do you want that chopped, sliced, or minced into a fine paste suitable for a kebab?
I had a pet pig once. We don't talk about what happened to him.
My mutton curry is legendary. It has brought grown men to tears. Mostly because of the chili.
Do not ask me where the chicken went. The chicken has ascended to a higher plane of deliciousness.
I wield this cleaver with the precision of a classical Kathak dancer.
If you bring me a rabbit, I will make you a stew that makes you forget your own name.
Vegetarians fear me. Vegans run from me. Cows... well, cows are safe.
The flesh is weak, but the barbecue is strong.
Every life must end, but not every life gets to be seasoned so perfectly.
leatherworker: This leather is so fine, it feels like the silk of a maharajah's pajamas.
I made these pants out of a very aggressive cow. You can feel the anger in the stitching.
Leather armor is not for protection. It is for making a fashion statement in the forest.
I tried making a leather umbrella for the monsoon. It just got soggy and smelled like wet dog.
Do you want it dyed? I have red, blue, and 'mysterious brown stain'.
A good saddle is the difference between riding a horse and being violently thrown into a ravine.
I work with leather because working with iron is too loud and gives me a headache.
These boots are made for walking. Specifically, walking away from my ex-wife.
The hide remembers the shape of the beast. Wear it with reverence.
Skin is just the boundary between the self and the universe. I just tan it.
mason: You want stone? I have stone. Big stone, small stone, square stone. Don't ask for round stone, are you crazy?
I chisel each block by hand. My fingers are basically made of granite now.
Do not build your house with dirt. Have some self-respect. Use polished diorite.
I was going to build a Taj Mahal, but I ran out of quartz. So I built a well instead.
The structural integrity of this brick is guaranteed. If it breaks, you broke it.
I find carving stone very relaxing. Except when I hit my thumb with the hammer. Then I invent new curse words.
Terracotta is the future. It is mud, but baked! Genius!
I can make a statue of you, but it will cost extra for the nose. Noses are hard.
A building without a strong foundation is like a curry without salt. Tragic.
We are all just dust and clay, trying to form ourselves into something permanent.
cartographer: I have mapped the known world. It is mostly water, dirt, and creepers.
Do not ask me for directions to your house. I only map things that are important.
This map is 100% accurate, except for the parts I made up because I was scared to go there.
I once got lost in my own village. That's when I realized the importance of good signage.
The compass always points to the world spawn. I find this philosophically troubling.
I sell maps to hidden treasures. The real treasure, of course, is the emeralds you give me.
I tried to map the monsoon clouds. They did not stay still. Very unprofessional.
A map is a window to the world. Don't smudge the glass with your greasy fingers.
You are here. But where is 'here' really? Existentially speaking.
The lines on a map are arbitrary borders drawn by mortals to pretend they have control.
librarian: Shhh! This is a library! Keep your block-placing noises down!
I have read every book here. Most of them are just pages of 'hurr durr' written by my cousin.
Enchanted books are very dangerous. Do not read them backwards, you will summon a tax collector.
I charge late fees in emeralds. Do not test me, I know a guy with a sword.
This book contains the ancient secrets of Vedic mathematics. It will help you calculate how broke you are.
Knowledge is power. And power is expensive. Pay up.
I once tried to write a novel. It was about a brave villager who never traded a single item. Tragic ending.
The paper is made from the finest sugarcane. Please do not chew on it.
A library is a temple of the mind. Please wipe your boots.
All words are just attempts to describe the indescribable silence of the void.
nitwit: I am not lazy, I am conserving my kinetic energy.
They call me a nitwit, but I am the only one who has figured out that work is a scam.
I watched a grass block turn into dirt today. It was a very productive morning.
Do you have any snacks? Being unemployed makes me very hungry.
I am currently meditating on the philosophical implications of the word 'Hmm'.
My mother says I have potential. I am keeping it hidden so nobody steals it.
I tried getting a job once. The uniform was itchy. Never again.
If you stand still long enough, the villagers forget you are there. It's my superpower.
The iron golem is my best friend. He never asks me what I'm doing with my life.
Why strive for greatness when you can achieve perfect mediocrity with zero effort?
none: I am looking for a profession. Do you know anyone hiring a professional cloud-watcher?
I am currently unemployed, but my resume is very strong. I can open doors AND close them.
I am thinking of becoming a cleric, but the glowing potions give me a headache.
Just waiting for someone to place a workstation. Any workstation. Please.
I have an entrepreneurial spirit, but zero capital and zero skills.
Do you think there's a market for selling imported sand to the desert villagers?
I spend my days wandering aimlessly. It is a form of active mindfulness.
I am the blank slate upon which the village writes its destiny.
Unemployment is just a prolonged period of self-discovery.
Without a profession, I am undefined. I am infinite potential. I am also very broke.

generic: Have you had your chai yet? The day cannot begin without chai.
The monsoon is coming. I can feel it in my left knee.
Do you want to buy some spices? No? Your food must be very sad.
I heard the iron golem is unionizing. Things are getting tense.
Ah, a traveler. Bring news from the outside world, or just bring emeralds.
Please do not run in the village, it disturbs the cows.
My astrologer said today would be a profitable day. Do not prove him wrong.
The mosquitoes here are the size of bats. Beware.
Life is a journey, not a destination. But the destination better have a bed.
In the grand cosmic dance of Shiva, your existence is but a fleeting spark. Want to trade?

greetings: I helped dad tend the wheat today! By tend, I mean I threw mud at the cows until one chased me.
Do you have any spare emeralds? I'm trying to save up to buy my own wooden hoe.
My brother told me if I sleep in a haystack, the phantom king will turn me into a turnip.
Watch out! The pig paddock has a mole trap, and I may have forgotten where I buried it.
I made a mud pie for lunch! It's extra crunchy because of the beetles.
Have you seen my pet chicken, Clucky? She's small, white, and currently fleeing from a fox.
Dad says if I work hard on the farm every day for fifty years, I might inherit half an acre of gravel!
I challenged the Iron Golem to a staring contest. My eyes burned after three hours.
My big sister said adventurers eat gravel for breakfast. Is that why your teeth look like that?
If you poke a sleeping pig, it grunts. If you poke it twice, it runs into the well.
I tried to ride a sheep yesterday. Wool is not as soft as it looks when it gets in your mouth.
Mom says my twin brother was taken by wolves, but I think he just ran away to avoid doing farm chores.
I'm practicing my war cry! *Ahem* ...Please don't step on my carrots!
Do you think scarecrows get lonely standing out in the rain all night? I gave mine a hug and got a tick.
I found a shiny yellow dandelion! I'm going to trade it to the butcher for a whole sausage.
I hid inside a hay bale during hide-and-seek. The horse tried to eat my hair.
The butcher says all the pigs go to a magical farm in the sky. Why is his apron always covered in red sauce then?
I tried to milk a cow, but I grabbed the wrong end and it kicked my hat into the chimney.
Look at my stick! It's shaped like a sword. Stand back, or I'll poke your knee!
If you dig straight down, you fall into lava. Everyone knows that! Except Tommy. We miss Tommy.
The village priest says hard work builds character. My feet say hard work builds blisters.
We used to have three cows and four children, but after the bad winter, now we have four cows and three children... wait.
Dad bought a new pitchfork today! Now he can yell at the crows twice as fast.
My brother went out to gather wood after dark last winter... now we have a nice extra room in the cottage!
I tried to weave a basket out of reeds, but it just looks like a depressed hat.
When I grow up, I want to be a blacksmith so I can smash hot iron and yell loudly!
Grandpa says back in his day, villagers didn't even have doors. The zombies just walked right in for dinner.
I'm guarding this patch of grass. If anyone treads on it, I'll inform the village elder!
We had turnip soup for breakfast, turnip soup for lunch, and guess what's for dinner? Turnips!
The last traveling trader left his llama behind. I tried to pet it and it spat in my eye.

cookie_success: A real sugar cookie?! Wow! My mom only makes cookies out of compressed sawdust and hope!
NOM NOM NOM! Best day ever! I'm never going back to eating raw carrots!
Thank you mister/lady! If I eat this fast enough, I don't have to share it with my sister!
cookie_fail_1: Hey, this isn't a cookie! This is just a dried lump of sheep manure!
You promised a cookie! Wheat husks don't count, no matter how hard you bake them!
Nice try, but I know what a beetle shell looks like. I'm not eating that!
cookie_fail_2: Gross! It tastes like a zombie slept on it! Did you dig this out of a ruin?!
Aw man, it's stale as a cobblestone block! I almost broke my milk teeth!
My mom warned me about strangers giving out burnt dough scraps. I'm telling the Iron Golem!
sugar_rush: WOOOOO! I CAN SMELL COLOURS AND RUN FASTER THAN A SPEED II POTION! WHEEEEEE!
I'M GONNA OUTRUN THE HORSES! I'M GONNA CARTWHEEL OVER THE SCARECROW! WATCH ME!
MY HEART IS BEATING LIKE A BLACKSMITH'S ANVIL! I CAN SEE THROUGH TIME!
sugar_fail: Ugh, my tummy feels like a Creeper's about to fuse inside it... I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag...
Ow... the world is spinning, and I think I hear angels playing harps in the pig pen...
I don't feel fast anymore... I just feel like lying in the mud until next spring...
toy_success: WHOA! A carved wooden horse with real wheels?! This is ten times better than my potato on a stick!
For me?! I'm gonna name him Sir Gallop-a-Lot and battle all the chickens in the yard!
Awesome! Now I can finally play knights and dragons instead of 'who can hold a brick longest'!
toy_fail: This is just a broken branch! I already have forty sticks in my backyard, and thirty of them are pointier!
You call this a toy? It's literally just a pinecone glued to a cobweb! I'm offended!
My dad makes better toys out of scrap iron and he doesn't even like me!
parents: My dad's a farmer! He spends all day yelling at crows and complaining about rain. Sometimes both!
Mom says if I don't finish my turnip rind, the bog monster will come and make me do the laundry.
My parents told me I was found under a cabbage leaf. But I think they bought me from a wandering trader for two emeralds.
rps_win: HA! Rock smashes scissors! I win! My medieval rock training finally paid off!
Yes! Victory is mine! You owe me one shiny pebble and your eternal respect!
Boom! Paper covers rock! You can't beat my tactical paper folding skills!
rps_lose: Aw man! Scissors cuts paper?! But paper is supposed to be mightier than the sword!
No way! You cheated! I bet you used enchanted rock-paper-scissors techniques!
Darn it... That's my third loss today. I'm going back to playing with mud.
rps_tie: Both rock?! We think alike! Are we secretly long-lost farm cousins?
Tie! Paper vs Paper! It's an aggressive slap of flat parchment!
Scissors meets scissors! Now we just look like two crabs trying to shake hands.
